how_it_works.eyebrow: METHODOLOGY // HOW THE AUDIT ENGINE WORKS
how_it_works.title: Four Safety Layers Before Capital Moves.
how_it_works.subtitle: Every financial thesis passes through deterministic math, daily macro telemetry, and a Pre-Mortem hearing before execution.

step1.title: Deterministic Math First, LLM Second
step1.body: Every critical ratio—Risk/Reward, BEP, cash runway, and Debt Service Ratio—is computed first by pure TypeScript engines in under a millisecond. The LLM is strictly forbidden from inventing figures outside those locked outputs.

step2.title: Autonomous Daily Macro Radar
step2.body: Our zero-dependency pipeline harvests USD/IDR, IHSG, Gold, and Bitcoin every morning into an isolated data branch. When the market regime shifts to RISK_OFF or CAUTIOUS, committee scrutiny tightens automatically.

step3.title: Optimistic Assumptions vs. Failure Reality
step3.body: Instead of validating your thesis, our Risk Division assumes your plan has already collapsed six months from today—then works backward to expose the 3 deadliest blind spots hiding in your numbers.
step3.left_text: Unit margin looks healthy at IDR 65k and payback feels achievable within a few busy months.
step3.right_text: Target of 210 units sits below the 224-unit BEP. A 40% slow-season dip burns through IDR 30M before month four.

step4.title: Bias Mirror & Instant What-If Slider
step4.body: Compare your initial confidence against mathematical resilience via the Optimism Bias Mirror. Once the verdict lands, drag the What-If Stress Slider to locate your plan's exact breaking point in real time with zero API cost.

memo.p1: Most retail traders hit by margin calls, small businesses running dry in month three, and households trapped by installments do not fail from a lack of information. They fail because the human brain naturally hunts for confirmation of a decision it already wants to make.
memo.p2: Unfortunately, most modern AI assistants amplify that bias. Trained to be agreeable, they wrap fragile financial plans in polite encouragement instead of pointing straight at the structural leak in the math.
memo.p3: TesisLab is built on one uncompromising rule: deterministic mathematics holds supreme veto power, while AI exists solely to dissect worst-case failure scenarios before real capital leaves your account.
memo.p4: This tool is not a licensed financial advisor and never promises quick returns. It is a cold stress-testing chamber for anyone who would rather be rejected by a calculator today than absorb avoidable ruin six months from now.
